Exercise: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_extension
- flexion

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- machine

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate to high

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- triceps_activation
- shoulder_strength_and_size

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Rotator cuff issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Arnold Press, description: Perform the movement with a slight forward lean and rotate the wrists as you press to target the front delts more.
- name: Lateral Raise, description: Focus on raising the weight out to the sides for an isolation focus on the lateral head of the deltoids.

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press, equipment: dumbbells
- exercise_name: Barbell Military Press, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Sit down on the Shoulder Press Machine and select the weight.
- Grab the handles to your sides as you keep the elbows bent and in line with your torso. This will be your starting position.
- Now lift the handles as you exhale and you extend the arms fully. At the top of the position make sure that you hold the contraction for a second.
- Lower the handles slowly back to the starting position as you inhale.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
